description: This file defines the pBubble class, which provides functionality for drawing and managing bubble charts, including scaling, rendering, and labeling of bubble chart data within the pChart library.

classes.name: pBubble
classes.description: A class to create, scale, and draw bubble charts, including handling colors, labels, and drawing shapes such as circles and squares.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method to initialize the pBubble object with chart and data objects.

methods.name: bubbleScale
methods.description: Calculates scaling boundaries for bubble sizes based on data and weight series.

methods.name: resetSeriesColors
methods.description: Resets colors of data series to their default palette.

methods.name: drawBubbleChart
methods.description: Draws the bubble chart on the specified chart area, including handling different shapes, borders, and image mapping.

methods.name: writeBubbleLabel
methods.description: Adds labels to individual bubbles, including optional formatting and positioning.
